item.title: Chiang Mai Air Pollution Among World’s Worst as Authorities Announce Emergency Controls
item.description: Air pollution in Chiang Mai, northern Thailand, has surged to among the worst levels globally, prompting the provincial governor to issue emergency restrictions and preventive measures on Thursday (March 5). According to the global air-quality monitoring website IQAir, Chiang Mai ranked eighth among the world’s most polluted cities.
